1088dcecf624a75713158f8d6d72c2847baf58ab.summary: Technical analysis of SmokeLoader, a malware family of the loader type that the text says was first revealed in 2011. The text says it can serve as a keylogger, information stealer, botnet or backdoor, and that it is spread through email and drive-by downloads. It also says SmokeLoader was the first to use PROPagate injection, which runs code inside a different application from the one that is running. The text is only an introduction excerpt, so it names no actors, sectors, countries, CVEs or figures.

1016ea444ad925f388c7bb7d3e7d16d2caa1c56b.summary: NadSec's technical teardown of Coruna, a multi-stage exploit chain against Apple Safari/WebKit and the XNU kernel on arm64e iOS and macOS devices. Delivery is by watering-hole compromise, with gambling and fake crypto-exchange lure pages. Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) is cited for attributing the operation to UNC6691. The report describes XOR string obfuscation, a Mach-O parser, several WebKit exploit primitives, a PAC bypass, and a kernel vulnerability (CVE-2023-41974). The supplied text ends partway through the XSLT trigger section, so the kernel stage, kill chain and attribution…
